thesis: Evidence-bounded thesis: General-purpose robot foundation models and policies intended to control different robot embodiments across tasks. Verified current scope: developer/test environment only; evidence level is stated in the claim ledger. Stated ambition: Company-stated ambition is a general physical-intelligence layer that transfers across robot embodiments and tasks. Public evidence supports responsibility for models/policies and simulation/training; does not establish responsibility for hardware, robot body, end effectors/tooling, integration, commissioning/qualification, remote operations, ongoing support/maintenance and hardware financing/RaaS. Overall integration responsibility is classified as developer_tool_only. Commercial evidence: 0_no_verified_deployment; technical evidence: 3_vendor_documented. These are public-evidence classifications, not proof of contract scope, uptime, economics or performance.
relevanceToIntegration: Enabling-layer comparator only: the company supplies developer, data, simulation, observability or orchestration tooling; public evidence does not show it owning physical integration or acceptance.
